=========================
Demo of cyPAPI Exceptions
=========================

cyPAPI exceptions follow the same logic as Python exceptions. Therefore, ``try`` and ``except``
blocks can be utilized to test code for errors and subsequently handle those errors in the way you desire. If
you are not familiar with Python exception handling then please see the Python documentation section
`Errors and Exceptions <https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/errors.html>`_ before continuing on.

.. code-block:: python

   import cypapi as cyp 

   # Initialize the cyPAPI library
   cyp.cyPAPI_library_init(cyp.PAPI_VER_CURRENT)

   # Create a cyPAPI event set
   eventset_obj = cyp.CypapiCreateEventset()

   # Get the component index for perf_event
   component_name = "perf_event"
   component_index = cyp.cyPAPI_get_component_index(component_name)

   # Assign the eventset to the perf_event component
   eventset_obj.assign_eventset_component(component_index)

   # Get a list of available native events for perf_event
   eventcode = 0 | cyp.PAPI_NATIVE_MASK
   modifier = cyp.PAPI_ENUM_FIRST
   native_event_dict, eventcode = cyp.cyPAPI_enum_event(eventcode, modifier)

   ## Store first event name
   list_of_event_names = []
   list_of_event_names.append(next(iter(native_event_dict)))

   ## Store second event name, note that this event name is fake
   ## This will trigger the exception CypapiEnoevnt
   list_of_event_names.append("perf::event_does_not_exist")

   ## Store the third event name
   modifier = cyp.PAPI_ENUM_EVENTS
   native_event_dict, _ = cyp.cyPAPI_enum_event(eventcode, modifier)
   list_of_event_names.append(next(iter(native_event_dict)))

   # Attempt to add the native events
   for eventname in list_of_event_names:
       try:
           eventset_obj.add_named_event(eventname)
       except cyp.CypapiEnoevnt:
           print(f"Unable to add the native event: {eventname}")
